metadata.owner: WS10 question-intent registry — W2-C / RVR-6b (OD-W2-WS10-SCOPE: per-domain instance)

records.primary_intent: Elicit how the system notices the problem and responds, in everyday words.
records.answer_objective: A plain-language description of the notice-and-respond behaviour.
records.completion_condition: The answer describes both how the problem is noticed and how the system responds.

records.primary_intent: Identify the main parts of the idea and each part's role.
records.answer_objective: A list of the main parts with what each part does.
records.completion_condition: The answer names the main parts and states each part's function.

records.primary_intent: Walk through the end-to-end sequence from problem start to notification.
records.answer_objective: A step-by-step account of what happens in order.
records.completion_condition: The answer traces the sequence step by step from start to outcome.

records.primary_intent: Surface the loosely-imagined or uncertain part of the mechanism.
records.answer_objective: An honest description of the part the inventor is unsure about.
records.completion_condition: The answer identifies which part is unsure or loosely imagined.

records.primary_intent: Establish what must be true for safe real-world operation.
records.answer_objective: The conditions required for the system to work safely.
records.completion_condition: The answer states at least one concrete safe-operation condition.

records.primary_intent: Establish what keeps the system running reliably over time.
records.answer_objective: The factors that sustain reliable long-term operation.
records.completion_condition: The answer states what keeps the system reliable over time.

records.primary_intent: Identify real-world conditions (heat, water, time, wear) that might stop it.
records.answer_objective: The environmental conditions that threaten operation, ranked by worry.
records.completion_condition: The answer names at least one threatening real-world condition.

records.primary_intent: Identify the single most valuable feasibility check an engineer could run.
records.answer_objective: The first thing an engineer should verify about physical workability.
records.completion_condition: The answer names one concrete thing to check first.

records.primary_intent: Bound which situations the system is responsible for handling.
records.answer_objective: The situations that are in the system's scope of responsibility.
records.completion_condition: The answer names the situations the system should handle.

records.primary_intent: Separate the idea's responsibility from someone or something else's job.
records.answer_objective: A split between what the idea does and what is another's job.
records.completion_condition: The answer separates the idea's responsibility from another party's.

records.primary_intent: Contrast a must-react situation with a must-stay-quiet situation.
records.answer_objective: One situation demanding reaction and one demanding silence.
records.completion_condition: The answer gives both a react case and a stay-quiet case.
